note: Sample assets embedded in the offline build. Files live in assets/samples/. Textures of lantern, pot-of-coals and candle-holder were re-encoded to 1024 px (JPEG/PNG) to keep the build small; geometry is unchanged. KayKit characters were split by scripts/prepare-kaykit.py: meshes in kaykit-<name>.glb, one shared, pruned animation library per rig (kind 'animations'), weapons and shields merged into kaykit-props.glb (kind 'props').
